notes.title: Closed Playtest Update - Version 0.4
notes.content:
[b]Change notes[/b]
[list]
- Area 5 (Clouds) added 
- Area 6 (Portals) added
- Area 7 (Portal Puzzle) added
- Area 8 (Conveyors & Springs) added
- Area 9 (Final) added
- Stats page updated with each new area
- Text warnings for unfair falls (funny tho)
- Text tutorials for new mechanics
- Print debugs removed, hopefully resolving some lag issues
[/list]
[b]Please note these known issues to avoid giving duplicate feedback:[/b]
[list]
- Character will turn green to indicate a successful spring bonus, resetting when you touch the ground. This will be art/animation/VFX/sound indicated in the future.
- Portal will flash to indicate the correct exit portal, this will be art/animation/VFX/sound indicated in the future
- Area 3 is currently undergoing some big changes and isn't possible to complete, please use the '4' hotkey to skip this area for now
- Area 8 and Area 9 - Springs Mechanics: Currently there is no indication when a spring is below you or when to use a spring bonus or not. Artwork will be added in future builds to make this clearer- at the moment it will be more trial and error
- Area 9 (Final) is incomplete
[/list]

[b]This is the first time I'm testing these new areas so please include video recordings of your initial gameplay if possible, and as always, message me with feedback or use the Discord channel <3 [/b]
